relevance_note: Single-patient case report of an FLD patient with a stated LCAT genotype: 'genetically proven FLD, due to homozygous Thr274Ile mutation in LCAT'.
method_note: Read the whole paper including the converted supplement (Table S1). Hand-built with a short Python script; table spans copied from Table S1 rows (patients-as-columns table not applicable; Table S1 columns are time points Baseline/Week-3/Week-6/EOT for the single patient; baseline column used). Year taken from the header line (2021); the printed citation in the article gives 'J Intern Med. 2022;291:364–370', so the year is ambiguous (online 2021 vs issue 2022). The genotype sentence cites reference [12] (a study of 13 Italian families), but the paper does not state that this patient was described there, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is left null. Age at diagnosis taken from 'At first referral ... at the age of 27, FLD was confirmed by kidney biopsy'; the paper also calls FLD 'genetically proven' without a date. Table S1 values not labelled by the authors as abnormal (triglycerides 235 mg/dL, LDL-cholesterol 54 mg/dL, apoB 53 mg/dL, haemoglobin 9.7 g/dL, unesterified/total cholesterol 0.80) were not turned into features; anemia, hypertriglyceridemia, low LDL and reduced cholesteryl ester fraction are left not reported even though the patient was on epoetin. Proteinuria is marked observed from the Table S1 'Proteinuria (g/day) 3.680' row and the text sentence on proteinuria; nephrotic syndrome not stated. 'Typical foamy appearance' refers to the GBM, not to foam cells, so glomerular foam cells left not reported. Hypertension is not stated (only anti-hypertensive therapy), so not recorded. Immunofluorescence slightly positive for C3, C1q, IgM ('likely unspecific') not recorded as features; negative C4d recorded as excluded. Native-biopsy findings (age 27) and graft-biopsy findings (pre-treatment) are recorded as separate feature rows. No contradictions found.
